attributes.title: Level 5

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about creating original pixel art that has depth, texture, and makes a project more unique!

questions.title: [Match one per answer]  Match the color types to their descriptions:

statements.text: Colors that are opposite each other on the color wheel, which can be used to enhance contrast in an image.
Colors that are next to each other on the color wheel, or near each other in MakeCode’s default color palette.

questions.correctResponse: Using analogous colors can help create depth and add texture to an image. Using complementary colors can help sprite images stand out on screen.

questions.hint: Which technique is used to create texture and to blend colors together?
questions.title: [Select one]  ______________ is a pixel art technique that creates texture by using a pattern of diagonal or checkered pixels to ease the transition between 2 colors.
questions.correctResponse: Dithering blends colors together, where there is more pixel space in the canvas.

questions.hint: A “jaggy” is a break in a smooth line in an image. Dithering is a pixel art technique that creates texture by using pixels in a diagonal or checkered pattern to ease the transition between 2 colors.
questions.title: [Match one per answer] ______________________ should be added in a color lighter than the base color. ______________________ should be added in a color darker than the base color.

statements.text: ______________________ should be added in a color lighter than the base color.
______________________ should be added in a color darker than the base color.

questions.correctResponse: The highlight should be placed on the same side as the light source. The shadow should be placed on the opposite side of the light source, showing how the light shines across the object.

questions.title: [Open response] Which pixel art technique are you most excited to explore in Level 5?
questions.correctResponse: Dithering, adding highlights/ shadows, removing jaggies, and other techniques all help make your pixel art POP!

subgroups.title: Pixel Art Strategies
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about creating original pixel art that has depth, texture, and makes a project more unique!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original pixel art images. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Pixel Artist
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original pixel art assets to be used in a project.

badges.title: Work of Art
badges.description: Create and refine original pixel art images in the MakeCode paint editor.

badges.title: Neat n’ Tidy
badges.description: Create smooth outlines by removing jaggies in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Color Wheel
badges.description: Use analogous or complementary colors to modify the level of contrast in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Depth Perception
badges.description: Add highlights and shadows to make a pixel art image look realistic.

badges.title: I’m Dithering Away!
badges.description: Use dithering to ease the transition between colors in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Up to Scale
badges.description: Create and refine multiple sizes of a pixel art image.
